dishes.desc: Black bean stew with pork cuts and sausages, served with rice, collard greens, farofa and orange slices.

dishes.name: Churrasco
dishes.desc: Skewered meats grilled over charcoal, carved tableside at churrascarias.

dishes.name: Pão de Queijo
dishes.desc: Chewy baked cheese rolls made from tapioca flour, eggs and cheese, from Minas Gerais.

dishes.name: Coxinha
dishes.desc: Teardrop-shaped fried dough croquette filled with shredded chicken and creamy cheese.

dishes.name: Brigadeiro
dishes.desc: Chocolate truffle of condensed milk, cocoa and butter rolled in sprinkles, served at birthday parties.

dishes.name: Moqueca
dishes.desc: Fish stew with coconut milk, tomatoes, onions and dendê oil, cooked in a clay pot.

dishes.name: Acarajé
dishes.desc: Bahian black-eyed pea fritters fried in dendê oil, split and filled with vatapá, shrimp and pepper sauce.

dishes.name: Farofa
dishes.desc: Toasted cassava flour, often with butter, onion or bacon, sprinkled over beans and grilled meat.

dishes.name: Caipirinha
dishes.desc: Cocktail of cachaça muddled with lime and sugar over ice.

dishes.name: Açaí Bowl
dishes.desc: Frozen açaí berry pulp blended thick and topped with granola, banana and honey.

dishes.name: Pastel
dishes.desc: Thin, crisp fried pastry with fillings such as ground beef, cheese or palm heart, sold at street markets.

dishes.name: Picanha

dishes.name: Tapioca

dishes.name: Vatapá
dishes.desc: Bahian creamy paste of bread, dried shrimp, coconut milk, peanuts and dendê oil.

dishes.name: Bobó de Camarão
dishes.desc: Shrimp in a creamy purée of cassava, coconut milk and dendê oil, from Bahia.

dishes.name: Quindim
dishes.desc: Glossy baked custard of egg yolks, sugar and grated coconut.

dishes.name: Beijinho
dishes.desc: Coconut and condensed milk sweet rolled in sugar and topped with a clove, a party treat.

dishes.name: Guaraná
dishes.desc: Sweet carbonated soft drink flavoured with the Amazonian guaraná fruit.

dishes.name: Escondidinho
dishes.desc: Casserole of dried or shredded meat hidden under mashed cassava or potato and gratinated with cheese.

dishes.name: Baião de Dois
dishes.desc: Northeastern dish of rice and beans cooked with dried beef, sausage and coalho cheese.

dishes.name: Galinhada

dishes.name: Feijão Tropeiro
dishes.desc: Beans mixed with cassava flour, bacon, sausage, eggs and collard greens, from Minas Gerais.

dishes.name: Cuscuz Paulista
dishes.desc: Moulded savoury cake of cornmeal with sardines, tomatoes, eggs and palm hearts, from São Paulo.

dishes.name: Pudim de Leite
dishes.desc: Condensed milk flan baked with caramel, denser and creamier than European versions.

dishes.name: Tacacá
dishes.desc: Amazonian hot soup of tucupi broth, mouth-numbing jambu leaves, dried shrimp and tapioca gum.

dishes.name: Carne de Sol
dishes.desc: Northeastern beef salted and briefly dried, grilled or fried and served with cassava and bottled butter.

dishes.name: Paçoca
dishes.desc: Crumbly sweet of ground roasted peanuts, sugar and cassava flour, eaten at June festivals.

dishes.name: Pamonha
dishes.desc: Fresh grated corn paste, sweet or with cheese, wrapped in corn husks and boiled.

dishes.name: Caldo de Cana
dishes.desc: Fresh sugarcane juice pressed at street stalls, often with lime, drunk with a pastel.

dishes.name: Poke
dishes.desc: Cubed raw ahi tuna or octopus marinated with soy sauce, sesame oil, onion and seaweed.

dishes.name: Kalua Pig
dishes.desc: Whole pig roasted in an underground imu oven with banana leaves, then shredded and salted for lūʻau.

dishes.name: Lomi-Lomi Salmon
dishes.desc: Side salad of salted salmon diced with tomatoes and onions, served chilled at lūʻau.

dishes.name: Poi
dishes.desc: Paste of steamed, pounded and often fermented taro corm, a Polynesian staple eaten with fingers.

dishes.name: Laulau
dishes.desc: Pork and salted fish wrapped in taro and ti leaves and steamed until tender.

dishes.name: Plate Lunch
dishes.desc: Takeout plate of two scoops of rice, macaroni salad and a main such as teriyaki beef or kalua pig.

dishes.name: Shave Ice
dishes.desc: Finely shaved ice drenched in flavoured syrups, sometimes over ice cream or azuki beans.

dishes.name: Malasadas

dishes.name: Haupia

dishes.name: Loco Moco
dishes.desc: Rice topped with a hamburger patty, fried egg and brown gravy, created in Hilo.

dishes.name: Spam Musubi
dishes.desc: Slice of grilled teriyaki-glazed Spam on a block of rice wrapped with nori.

dishes.name: Huli Huli Chicken
dishes.desc: Chicken grilled over mesquite and basted with sweet pineapple, soy and ginger sauce, sold at roadside fundraisers.

dishes.name: Saimin

dishes.name: Manapua

dishes.name: Shrimp Truck Garlic Shrimp
dishes.desc: Shrimp sautéed in butter and lots of garlic and served with rice from North Shore Oahu food trucks.

dishes.name: Chicken Long Rice
dishes.desc: Chicken simmered with ginger and cellophane noodles in broth, a lūʻau staple.

dishes.name: Kona Coffee
dishes.desc: Coffee grown on the volcanic slopes of the Big Island's Kona district, smooth and low in acidity.

dishes.name: Butter Mochi
dishes.desc: Chewy baked cake of glutinous rice flour, coconut milk, butter and eggs.
